arguments.command:
cd /workspace/dev && for e in 200 400 700; do python3 hard3.py /tmp/hard3.json $e >/dev/null; cd /workspace && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/site python3 - <<EOF
import sys, json, io, time, resource
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import formats, pipeline
data=open('/tmp/hard3.json','rb').read()
t=time.time(); parsed=formats.read_request(io.BytesIO(data))
out=pipeline.execute(parsed); dt=time.time()-t
c=out['catalog'][0]
widths=[hi-lo+1 for cl in c['clusters'] for lo,hi in cl['range']]
print('eps=$e total %.2fs frags %d clusters %d kept %d avgwidth %.0f rss %dMB'%(dt,len(c['fragments']),len(c['clusters']),len(c['priority']),sum(widths)/max(1,len(widths)),resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024))
EOF
cd /workspace/dev; done
